text:
In case it's relevant to others in the future: I went to Misrad Hapnim, walk-in appointment at 8:00 for תעודת לידה. 
I told the clerk I need the official Birth Certificate that is in Hebrew and English for the USA Embassy. On this English/Hebrew document, my surname (of my father) was clearly written in English and Hebrew.
Since the Certificate is printed at Misrad Hapnim, I do not need to get it notarized or Apostille to submit to the Embassy.
